On Nov 9th at Wimbledon, Alan Morrison and Roger Hudson---both members of Belgrave Harriers!---both members of the Aristotle school!---both won their Championship races, Intermediate and Junior!---both set new course records!
At the same meeting Roger Hudson was our first lad home in the Boy's race, followed by J.Allan and young Pearson, whose action looks more like father Geoff's each time out.

LACEY - 15 year old ROGER HUDSON is seen here winning the BOYS 880 yards in 2 minutes 9.5 seconds at the Club Championships on May 27th. Roger will be representing London in the All-England Schools Championships later this month, over 440 yards, and has a best time to his credit of 52.9 seconds.
In the All-England Schools Championships held at Chesterfield on July 22nd, Roger Hudson scored a fine victory in the Junior Boys 440 yards, with a winning time of 53.1 seconds.
This has been a record-breaking season for Roger Hudson. Aristotle School, South London and London Schools 440 yards records have all fallen to him this year.
In the Boys events, strongly built Roger Hudson broke the 100 yards record in his heat with a time of 11.2. In the final, however, he was forced to give way to the other heat winner, R.
Roger Hudson had a remarkable season, winning both the All England and London Schools' Championships. A 52.9 quarter at 15 years of age stamps him as a great prospect.

Roger Hudson also deserves credit for his 220 and 440 running. Without wishing to blow our own trumpets too much, this match went some way towards proving that we are Junior-wise, one of the top Clubs in the area.

Keep it under your hat but did I see Roger Hudson making a come back at the ripe old age of 19. Members may remember when Roger won the All England Schools 440y in 1961 as a 'boy' with a time of 53.1 .
